title: Image Generation Module
summary: This module orchestrates the process of generating images from various inputs, leveraging machine learning models and frameworks like MLX. It handles model loading, generation execution, and output processing.

nodes.label: User Request
nodes.title: Image Generation Request
nodes.description: Input from the user, typically a text prompt and generation parameters, initiating the image creation process.

nodes.label: MLX Dynamic Loading
nodes.title: MLX Library Loader
nodes.description: Handles the dynamic loading and initialization of the MLX machine learning library, ensuring it's available for use by the generation components.

nodes.label: Load Image Model
nodes.title: Image Model Loader
nodes.description: Responsible for loading the specific image generation model (e.g., Stable Diffusion weights) into memory, often utilizing MLX capabilities for efficient data handling.

nodes.label: Execute Image Generation
nodes.title: Image Generation Core
nodes.description: The central component that takes the processed input and the loaded model to perform the actual image synthesis using MLX operations and algorithms.

nodes.label: Output Generated Image
nodes.title: Generated Image Output
nodes.description: Processes and delivers the final generated image, potentially applying post-processing, format conversion, or saving it to a specified location.

nodes.label: MLX Framework
nodes.title: MLX Machine Learning Framework
nodes.description: The underlying machine learning framework (e.g., Apple MLX) that provides tensor computation, model execution, and GPU acceleration for image generation tasks.

nodes.label: LLM Runtime Core
nodes.title: LLM Runtime Core
nodes.description: The core runtime for Large Language Models, which might provide text embeddings, semantic understanding, or other multimodal features as input to the image generation process.

groups.label: Input & Setup
groups.title: Image Generation Input & Setup
groups.description: This group handles receiving user requests, dynamically loading necessary machine learning libraries, and preparing the image generation model for use.

groups.label: Core Generation Process
groups.title: Core Image Generation & Output
groups.description: This group encompasses the central logic for executing the image generation process and managing the delivery of the final generated image.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External ML & LLM Dependencies
groups.description: This group represents the external machine learning frameworks and language model runtimes that provide core computational and semantic capabilities to the image generation module.
